summary.text: Nicholas Sokaris is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 111 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Angelo Santabarbara (Democratic / People First Party).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked for nearly four years as a legislative analyst in the New York State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Nicholas Sokaris earned a high school diploma from Guilderland High School, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a legislative staffer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked for nearly four years as a legislative analyst in the New York State Assembly before running for office.
Sokaris said in the survey that his campaign focuses on affordability, practical solutions and government accountability, including reducing regulations that raise housing costs.
He said he supports building an "Upstate Caucus" in the legislature and expanding childcare options.
